expo.name: Umi: Eating Disorder Support
expo.description: An eating disorder support app to reflect without judgement, get personalized insights, and learn along the way. Designed to be a supportive tool, not a replacement for professional care.

plugins.photosPermission: umi accesses your photos so you can attach images to your quest reflections.
plugins.cameraPermission: umi accesses your camera so you can add photos to your quest reflections.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: umi uses your location to show nearby professional support and resources.
